in_sanskrit.name: कृतिका
in_sanskrit.meaning: The one who creates or forms
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who creates, forms or crafts. Derived from the root word कृ् (kri), meaning to create or form. Kṛtika is also the name of a constellation in the northern celestial hemisphere, representing the goddess of creation, Krishna or Lakshmi.

in_hindi.name: कृतिका

in_tamil.name: க்ரிதிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who makes or creates. Derived from the Tamil word கோலம் (kōlam), meaning to create or make. In Tamil, Krithika is written as க்ரிதிகா (Kṛthikā).

in_telugu.name: కృదిక

in_marathi.name: Krithika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Stars, Constellation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krithika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Krithika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kritika', which means 'the tenth', 'the one who sees' or 'the constellation Ursa Major'. In Hindu mythology, the constellation Ursa Major is believed to be a representation of the goddess Kritika, who is considered the goddess of stars and constellations. She is also believed to be the goddess of the harvest and the giver of knowledge.
